blocks.text: Collecting market insights means gathering and analysing information about target customers, competitors and the overall market, to make informed decisions on strategy, products and marketing.

blocks.prompt: What is the purpose of collecting market insights (MCQ 5)? Why is market research important for a new business (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: (b) to understand customer needs and market trends. A new business has no track record, so research shows whether people want the product, what they will pay, who the competitors are and how to stand out, reducing the risk of failure.

items: Market insight: know customers, competitors and the market before deciding.
